title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Fully Leveraging the Role of Criminal Trial Functions to Severely Punish Crimes of Infringing Intellectual Property Rights and Producing and Selling Counterfeit and Shoddy Goods According to Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Fully Exerting the Role of Criminal Adjudication Functions to Severely Punish Crimes of Infringing Intellectual Property Rights and Manufacturing and Selling Counterfeit and Shoddy Goods

Fa [2010] No. 431

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights and maintain a fair and orderly market environment, the State Council issued the "Special Action Plan for Combating Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights and Manufacturing and Selling Counterfeit and Shoddy Goods" in October 2010, proposing a nationwide concentrated special action from October 2010 to March 2011 to combat infringement of intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods. Through the implementation of the special action, a number of major cases of intellectual property infringement of domestic and international concern shall be seriously investigated and dealt with, a number of law-breaking enterprises shall be exposed, and a high-pressure posture against intellectual property infringement shall be formed. In order to cooperate with the implementation of this special action, effectively curb criminal activities of infringing intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods, earnestly protect intellectual property rights, and maintain the socialist market economic order, the relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. Raise awareness of intellectual property protection and ensure the smooth implementation of the special action

Criminal activities of infringing intellectual property rights directly infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of right holders, interfere with normal production and business order. Counterfeit and shoddy infringing goods also directly threaten the safety of people's lives and property and seriously affect the national image. Protecting intellectual property rights is an important part of building a country governed by the rule of law and perfecting the socialist market economic system. People's courts at all levels must fully recognize the importance of intellectual property protection, increase the intensity of criminal judicial protection of intellectual property rights, actively participate in the national special action against infringement of intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods, and fully exert the functional role of the people's courts in cracking down on crimes of infringing intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods. A number of criminal cases of infringing intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods that are serious in circumstances and have a vile influence, as well as related commercial bribery criminal cases, shall be tried in a centralized manner. Through the trial activities, the awareness of integrity and law-abiding among enterprises shall be enhanced, consumers' ability to identify counterfeits shall be improved, a social atmosphere of consciously resisting counterfeit and shoddy goods and attaching importance to intellectual property protection shall be formed, and a favorable environment for intellectual property rights shall be created. While fulfilling the adjudication function, the relationship between daily intellectual property protection work and the special action shall be properly handled, providing strong judicial guarantees for the special action, ensuring its smooth implementation, and consolidating the results achieved by the special action.

2. Highlight key points in trial work and increase the intensity of criminal crackdown on intellectual property crimes

People's courts at all levels shall perform their adjudication duties in accordance with the law, effectively exert the role of criminal justice in protecting intellectual property rights, crack down on and curb criminal activities of infringing intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods, and realize the functions of punishment and crime prevention through penalties. A high-pressure posture against intellectual property infringement crimes shall be maintained, and criminals who infringe intellectual property rights and manufacture and sell counterfeit and shoddy goods shall be severely punished in accordance with the law. In specific trial work, emphasis shall be placed on protecting copyrights, trademark rights, patent rights, and new plant variety rights as key content; on focusing on key rectification areas such as the press and publishing industry, cultural entertainment industry, high-tech industry, and agriculture; and on key products to be investigated and dealt with such as books, audio-visual products, software, bulk export goods, auto parts, mobile phones, medicines, and seeds. The trial and adjudication of criminal cases of infringing intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods shall be accelerated to timely and effectively crack down on such criminal acts. While applying principal penalties in accordance with the law, the application and enforcement of fine penalties shall be strengthened, and attention shall be paid to adopting measures such as confiscating illegal gains, seizing criminal tools, and destroying infringing products to economically deprive criminals of the ability and conditions to commit crimes again.

3. Strengthen inter-departmental communication and cooperation to enhance the efficiency of criminal trial work

Communication and coordination with public security organs, procuratorial organs, and relevant competent departments of intellectual property rights shall be further strengthened, and close cooperation shall be maintained to ensure the smooth progress of all stages including case filing, investigation, approval of arrest, review for prosecution, supplementary investigation, and trial. For major cases of intellectual property infringement and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods that are serious in circumstances and have a vile influence, the people's courts shall jointly supervise and handle the cases with public security organs and procuratorial organs, fully exerting their respective functional roles to form a joint force to crack down on criminal activities of infringing intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods.

4. Deeply investigate and research key issues to form a long-term working mechanism

Through the implementation of the special action against infringement of intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods, experience in criminal trials of such cases shall be promptly summarized, problems urgently needing resolution in trial work shall be deeply studied, effective solutions shall be proposed, and relatively mature measures shall be institutionalized and normalized. This will improve trial quality and efficiency, making the special action an opportunity to promote trial work and enhance trial capacity, and lay a solid foundation for forming a long-term mechanism in criminal trials of infringement of intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods.

5. Strengthen publicity and public opinion guidance to create a favorable public opinion atmosphere

Multiple forms shall be adopted to vigorously publicize the state's policies, laws, and regulations on intellectual property protection, raise the awareness of intellectual property protection across the entire society, and form a strong public opinion momentum for all sectors of society to jointly resist and crack down on criminal activities of infringing intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods. Typical cases of infringement of intellectual property rights and manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods shall be published at appropriate times to effectively deter criminals. For the publicity and reporting of major cases, public opinion analysis and assessment shall be strengthened, public opinion shall be correctly guided, and unified standards and release channels shall be adopted to prevent undesirable hype and ensure the best publicity effects.

Upon receipt of this notice, all localities shall promptly communicate it to the people's courts at various levels within their jurisdiction and shall implement it conscientiously. Any new situations or problems encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

November 25, 2010
